protocol.M_corpora: Strict M77 separately from direction1,known-undoubted multi-document flat arrays used only as source locators, never merge counts or establish same-object identity.
protocol.context_check: For all strict rows report direct adjacency W400 before each W525/W526/W527 in file order, exact W400 deletion/addition counterparts at that adjacency, grouped by literal string. No p-value; source-exposed description.
